games:2026-wk12-kentucky-missouri.blurb: No. 16 Kentucky heads to Columbia as a 5.5-point underdog, with ESPN giving Missouri a 61.5% shot at the upset of the ranked visitor. A total of 48.5 points to a grinding afternoon, and the Wildcats can't afford another slip.

games:2026-wk12-ucla-michigan.blurb: No. 4 UCLA heads to Ann Arbor as just a 3.5-point favorite with a 37.5 total, and ESPN's model sees it as close to a coin flip at 52.9%. The Bruins are the Big Ten's current leader, so a slip in a low-scoring slugfest would reshuffle the league's automatic bid.

games:2026-wk12-ohio-state-nebraska.blurb: No. 14 Ohio State is only a field goal better than Nebraska in Lincoln, with a tight 41.5 total pointing to a defensive slugfest. ESPN gives the Buckeyes a 71% chance, but a surging bubble team has everything to lose here.

games:2026-wk12-texas-tech-baylor.blurb: No. 12 Texas Tech is a 3.5-point favorite at Baylor in the week's most dangerous Big 12 road trip, with ESPN giving the Red Raiders a 61.4% edge. Sitting on the playoff cut line, Tech can't let a 55.5-point shootout get away.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-utah-tcu.blurb: No. 2 Utah visits TCU laying seven, with ESPN giving the Utes a 73.5% shot. Utah leads the Big 12 race and has the most to lose in a late-night road spot.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-houston-west-v.blurb: No. 20 Houston is an 8.5-point road favorite at West Virginia with the total up at 70.5 and a 72.7% win probability. A tidy win keeps the Cougars' ranking intact heading into the final stretch.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-byu-kansas.blurb: No. 10 BYU goes to Lawrence favored by 5.5 with a modest 47.5 total, and ESPN gives the Cougars a 71% shot. Still chasing Utah in the Big 12, BYU needs every win to stay in the automatic-bid conversation.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-iowa-illinois.blurb: No. 15 Iowa is an 8.5-point favorite at Illinois with the total down at 40.5 -- exactly the kind of low-scoring Big Ten game the Hawkeyes want. ESPN has Iowa at 65.3%, and a team on the outside of the field can't afford a stumble.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-arizona-kansas.blurb: No. 19 Arizona is a seven-point road favorite at Kansas State, with ESPN putting the Wildcats of Tucson at 74.5%. The total sits at 52.5.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-lsu-tennessee.blurb: Unranked LSU is a 1.5-point favorite at No. 9 Tennessee, and ESPN's model splits it almost exactly down the middle at 50.1%. With the total at 45.5, expect a tight, defense-tilted night in Knoxville.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-arkansas-texas.blurb: No. 5 Texas hosts Arkansas as a 20.5-point favorite with ESPN's model at 94.2%. The low 46.5 total suggests the Longhorns plan to win this one the methodical way.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-smu-notre-dame.blurb: No. 6 Notre Dame welcomes SMU as a 20.5-point favorite with a 56.5 total and a 93.5% win probability. Style points still matter for the Irish at this stage.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-maryland-usc.blurb: No. 18 USC is a 17.5-point home favorite over Maryland and a 93.1% pick by ESPN. With a 57.5 total, the Trojans should have room to pile up points.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-vanderbilt-flo.blurb: No. 24 Florida is a 13.5-point home favorite over Vanderbilt, with ESPN giving the Gators an 84.7% chance. A newly ranked team gets a chance to prove it belongs.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-texas-a-m-okla.blurb: No. 22 Oklahoma favored by 7.5 over Texas A&M with the total at just 38.5 -- points will be at a premium in Norman. ESPN gives the Sooners a 61.7% edge in what projects as a defensive grind.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-indiana-washin.blurb: No. 8 Indiana goes west as a 7.5-point favorite at Washington, with ESPN's model at 78.6%. The Hoosiers are chasing UCLA in the Big Ten and a road win keeps the pressure on.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-chattanooga-al.blurb: No. 3 Alabama hosts FCS Chattanooga in a game with no line posted. It's a tune-up for a Tide team sitting right behind Georgia in the SEC race.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-wofford-ole-mi.blurb: No. 25 Ole Miss hosts FCS Wofford in a game ESPN's model pegs at 99.7% for the Rebels. No line posted, and no suspense expected.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-pittsburgh-lou.blurb: No. 23 Louisville lays 14 at home against Pittsburgh with a 50.5 total, and ESPN gives the Cardinals a 77.5% shot. A comfortable win keeps Louisville in the rankings.

predictions:kentucky.blurb: Kentucky slid from 11th to 16th, and the advanced numbers are skeptical of the Wildcats holding on -- SP+ has them 42nd, FPI 34th.

predictions:ohio-state.blurb: Ohio State climbed six spots to No. 14, and the models think there's more room to rise: SP+ has the Buckeyes 4th and FPI 5th, far ahead of their poll slot.

predictions:ucla.blurb: UCLA holds steady at No. 4, but the models aren't fully on board — 12th in SP+ and 25th in FPI suggest the Bruins' ranking is running ahead of their profile.

predictions:houston.blurb: Houston tumbled from 14th to 20th, and the metrics don't offer much of a defense -- 25th in SP+, 30th in FPI.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-ten.blurb: UCLA sits atop the Big Ten at No. 4 with No. 8 Indiana four spots back -- close enough that one Bruins slip flips the league's auto bid.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-12.blurb: No. 2 Utah has the Big 12 lead well in hand, with No. 10 BYU eight spots back as the nearest chaser. The Cougars likely need help, not just wins.

bubbleNotes:ohio-state.blurb: Ohio State is the 15 seed and climbing fast, up six spots this week, but still sits three places outside the field.

bubbleNotes:texas-tech.blurb: Texas Tech holds steady at the 13 seed, a single spot from the field. First team out, and the next result decides everything.

bubbleNotes:iowa.blurb: Iowa sits at the 16 seed and didn't move this week, leaving the Hawkeyes four spots from the field with time running short.

games:2026-wk12-georgia-south-carolina.blurb: No. 1 Georgia heads to Columbia a 16.5-point favorite over No. 21 South Carolina, with ESPN's model giving the Bulldogs an 87% shot. A 50.5 total says points will be at a premium, and the Gamecocks need a ranked scalp to stay in the national conversation.

games:2026-wk12-san-diego-state-boise-st.blurb: No. 17 Boise State is laid 17.5 at home against San Diego State with a 61.5 total, and ESPN pegs the Broncos at 93.8% to win. Style points matter here -- Boise State is trying to keep climbing, and a sloppy night against an unranked visitor would stall that.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-oregon-michiga.blurb: No. 13 Oregon visits Michigan State as a 16.5-point favorite with a modest 44.5 total, and ESPN gives the Ducks an 86.3% win probability. With Oregon sitting just outside the field, this is a game to win cleanly and move on.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-wake-forest-ge.blurb: No. 11 Wake Forest is a 21-point road favorite at Georgia Tech, a 92.5% play by ESPN's numbers, with the total up at 56.5. The Demon Deacons can't afford a stumble while chasing Miami in the ACC.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-virginia-tech-.blurb: No. 7 Miami hosts Virginia Tech favored by 20.5 with a 60.5 total, and ESPN puts the Hurricanes at 96.4%. Miami controls its own ACC fate, so the only real question is whether the margin matches the billing.

predictions:boise-state.blurb: Boise State jumped from 24 to 17, and the advanced numbers mostly back the move -- SP+ has the Broncos 22nd, FPI a touch cooler at 31st. Keep winning in the Pac-12 and the poll gap closes on its own.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-sec.blurb: The SEC's automatic bid is the tightest race on the board: No. 1 Georgia leads, but No. 3 Alabama is only two spots back and one Bulldog slip from taking over.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-acc.blurb: Miami holds the ACC's auto bid at No. 7 with No. 11 Wake Forest four spots behind -- enough cushion to feel comfortable, not enough to coast.

bubbleNotes:oregon.blurb: Oregon is trending the right way, climbing three spots to the 14 seed and now sitting just two spots outside the field. The Ducks don't need help so much as they need to stop giving the committee reasons to look elsewhere.
